Recommendations.Name: Jake Attis
Recommendations.Title: Senior Architect | VPO Construction Project Management Software & Services | Azure, M365, .NET | Former 12-Year Microsoft MVP
Recommendations.Relationship: Worked with Joshua on the same team
Recommendations.Text:
I worked closely with Joshua for more than two years at VPO, collaborating with him on numerous application development and cloud engineering initiatives. He consistently impressed me with his exceptional work ethic, technical curiosity, humility, and dedication. Joshua is the kind of engineer who can quickly master an unfamiliar problem, develop a thoughtful solution, document it thoroughly, and stay engaged until the work is done correctly.

One of the best examples was our construction drawing issuance system, a particularly complex and demanding project. The system began with a PowerShell-based solution that Joshua authored. As its requirements evolved, he helped guide me through modernizing it into an Azure Durable Functions architecture. I developed much of the Azure Functions implementation, but Joshua remained an invaluable partner throughout the process, helping us overcome difficult technical challenges and carrying forward the deep knowledge he had built through the original system. His combination of technical ability, ownership, and willingness to collaborate made a significant difference.

Joshua also stands out in how effectively he uses AI for rapid prototyping and software development. He approaches new tools with curiosity and sound judgment, using them to accelerate delivery while still producing well-considered, maintainable solutions.

Above all, Joshua is dependable, passionate about his work, and continually learning. He consistently exceeds expectations, and I would work with him again without hesitation. I strongly recommend him to any organization seeking a dedicated software or cloud engineer who will make an immediate and lasting contribution.

Josh is an exceptional developer, a strong technical leader, and a teammate I would be excited to work with again.

Recommendations.Title: IT Pro | Azure & Microsoft 365
Recommendations.Relationship: Worked with Joshua on the same team
Recommendations.Text:
I have had the honor of working with Josh on two separate occasions, first during his years as a cloud administrator and then more recently as a front-end application developer. Josh found great success in both seats.

What makes Josh unique is his pursuit of the optimal. If he sees issues or inefficiencies, he will troubleshoot, research, design and build to a high degree. His passion for understanding the latest technologies and the opportunities they create has led to an impressive portfolio of work for him.

Specifically, he recently designed and implemented a custom BI Analytics tool for our construction customers that allowed quick insight into critical KPIs affecting project delivery and costs. Beyond that, he was key in standing up an internal administration app that provided centralized control over a wide spread of cloud resources on a single pane. Finally, he architected a comprehensive drawing issuance system that permitted large-volume clients to upload, process and organize thousands of construction drawings into a searchable catalog, ensuring fluidity in a process that is notoriously marked by friction and inefficiency.
